Mirzapur: The Movie Released, Garnering Mixed Reviews and Audience Reactions

Mirzapur: The Movie, the big-screen adaptation of the popular web series, has been released in theaters. Early audience reactions and reviews are emerging on social media platforms like Twitter. The film features Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, and Divyenndu. While some reviews praise the performances of the lead actors, particularly Tripathi and Divyenndu, and describe the film as a 'peak mass entertainer' or 'powerful than the web series,' others note pacing issues and an overlong runtime. The soundtrack of the movie has also been released, with the full album made available first to premium music streaming subscribers.
